responsive.web: copy left; dominant personal-surface portrait right
responsive.tablet: portrait expands into dominant right field; copy may overlap visual field
responsive.mobile: identity/name/formula first; portrait below at full content width

eventPresentation.responsiveRule: reuse one approved event image and crop it; never invent a new composition per breakpoint
eventPresentation.detailRelation: Dementor is rendered as a related entity with personal background, not as a second hero

homePresentation.heroMediaRole: dominant right-side media inside the first screen; never a detached downstream figure
homePresentation.heroCropPolicy: retain the complete approved illustration; increase the media field before allowing crop
homePresentation.desktop: one composition: metadata + headline + supporting copy on the left, dominant media field on the right
homePresentation.tablet: same composition with a larger proportional media field and reduced headline width
homePresentation.mobile: reflow: copy first, the same media remains inside the hero below the copy

listPresentation.rule: hover, focus or selected accent surface spans the viewport while row content stays fixed on the content grid
listPresentation.legacyMechanism: translateX accent layer clipped by row overflow is deprecated on Home
listPresentation.futureGeneralization: promote to shared entity register only after visual QA on Events, Projects, Community and Merch indexes
